summary: Retest of the iteration_21 MEDIUM scroll issue: FIXED. Full E2E /apply -> /payment -> Hubtel sandbox success -> /success on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844. Before submit, scrollY was 1508 (desktop) and 2592 (mobile). On /payment, scrollY=0 and payment-independence-notice is fully in view above payment-hubtel-btn (desktop top 249-329 of 800; mobile 245-377 of 844). /success opens at scrollY=0 and success-independence-notice is fully in view (desktop 548-628; mobile 624-772). An elementFromPoint check shows nothing covers the notice. Both TEST_ applications were deleted (DELETE 200, then GET 404). USDT was not used.

issues: The floating chat and WhatsApp buttons (bottom-right) partly cover the 'Track my application' button on /success and the 'Pay with USDT' buttons on /payment until the user scrolls. Low priority: consider extra bottom padding on mobile.
The 'Payment gateway in SANDBOX mode' banner breaks into three columns ('SANDBOX' sits alone in the middle). Cosmetic, and it only shows in preview.

action_items: Optional: add bottom padding on mobile so the floating chat/WhatsApp buttons don't cover the main buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Payment.jsx line 21 and Success.jsx line 10: window.scrollTo(0,0) in a mount useEffect is correct. A global ScrollToTop on route change would cover the other pages too.
seed_data_creation: Created GH-2026-481510 and GH-2026-636988 (TEST_Scroll desktop/mobile). Both deleted.
